preserved_contract: Every original archive byte, member, unique ledger entry, JSONL and scientific array is verified; no filtering of the archive.
Original remote outputs remain until independently verified source plus advertised mirror recovery and separate cleanup release.
Existing2A collectors remain immutable; this is a distinct future protocol.
pipeline: Freeze exact archive SHA/size, member ledger, metadata cap, source HEAD, current branch and advertised mirror head under an exclusive lane/Git write window.
Stream remote archive into a bounded48MiB RAM chunk buffer (below50MiB blob limit); compute per-chunk and whole SHA256, enforce total-size ceiling.

Write each chunk directly through git hash-object -w --stdin; retain returned Git object ID and verify cat-file size/content SHA. Never create a working archive/chunk file. Partial/failing objects and attempt receipt remain preserved without retry.

Read concatenated Git blobs through a bounded reader into streaming tar verification; reject symlinks/traversal/duplicates, verify exact all-original ledger and released metadata selection. Expand only bounded metadata.

Use a temporary isolated index initialized from frozen sourceHEAD; add archive blob OIDs at exact prospective artifact paths via update-index --cacheinfo plus metadata, write tree and source commit. Do not change caller index until branch CAS update succeeds; no reset or destructive overwrite.

Create and push codeonly mirror with same blob objects. Require advertised previous mirror identity matches frozen expected head; no unbounded fetch/repack/GC. Verify remote advertisement and local source/mirror trees contain exactly the same chunk blobs and metadata.

Perform independent complete recovery stream from both source and mirror histories; only then record cold descriptor and lifecycle for never-materialized working chunk paths. Integrate working index/branch in explicitly reviewed sequence so no misleading tracked deletions or skip-worktree state is hidden.

peak_disk_bound.archive_git_objects: For each chunk of n bytes, header plus payload N=n+len(blob-header); zlib compressBound(N)=N+(N>>12)+(N>>14)+(N>>25)+13, rounded up to filesystem block allocation. Sum across chunks. No compression credit.
peak_disk_bound.temporary_objects: Reserve one additional maximum compressed chunk for hash-object temporary destination/rename conservatively, even where rename should share an inode.
peak_disk_bound.metadata: Reserve twice declared expanded metadata cap for warm files and incompressible Git objects, plus bounded index/tree/commit and receipt allowance.
peak_disk_bound.mirror: Same source/mirror content reuses Git blob OIDs; no second archive object allocation. Push must stream pack to remote, no local packfile; prohibit GC/repack and audit helper paths. Unexpected external remote changes abort before fetch.
peak_disk_bound.fixed_floor: 10GiB free plus256MiB miscellaneous unchanged. Additional64MiB index/tree/helper overhead proposed; must be justified against exact lane path count before release.
peak_disk_bound.limits: This is a conservative proposed bound, not yet source-verified. Disk peak witness and failure receipts required. Mirror/index helper behavior and external writers remain explicit prerequisites.

unresolved_before_implementation: Review failure recovery around commit-tree/update-ref CAS and caller-index synchronization. Prefer two explicit commits: immutable full archive tree then cold lifecycle, with both mirrored, without ever materializing chunks.
Prove no local pack files or automatic maintenance are created by exact mirror command path; otherwise include their worst-case allocation.
Choose bounded archive/member verification reader and retain full-stream proof before cold receipt.
Independent source review and exact measured release required before any Git-object writing or collection.
